name: Amap
description: Find places and nearby spots in China, and plan walking, cycling and driving routes with Amap Web Service APIs.
installationSteps: This plugin is not enabled by default. Add it only when you intend to use Amap's services.
Create an Amap Open Platform key with the Web Service service platform selected.
Read Amap's Web Service API terms and check the agreement box before installing.
Amap coordinates are converted at the plugin boundary so map presentations continue to use the application's standard coordinate format.

setupFields.label: I agree to Amap's Web Service API terms
setupFields.helpText: Read the current terms at https://lbs.amap.com/pages/law-web-service/ before enabling this plugin.

setup.title: Connect Amap
setup.description: Uses Amap Web Service APIs for place search, nearby search and route planning. A Web Service API key is required.
steps: Create or open an application in the Amap Open Platform console.
Add a key with the service platform set to Web Service. A Web JS API key is not accepted.
The key is stored in the connected account and passed only to the local plugin process.
Amap sends place queries, search areas and route coordinates to its Web Service APIs.

fields.label: Amap Web Service API key
fields.helpText: Use a Web Service key from the Amap Open Platform, not a Web JS API key.

skills.name: amap-places
skills.description: When the user asks about places in China, nearby businesses, opening hours or routes and Amap is connected.
